ratnajaṃ lohajaṃ vātha liṃgaṃ kṛtvā sayonikam

varāhaṃ ca gajaṃ caiva veśyā cātyantasundarī
darśanena ca mṛdbhāṇḍaiḥ tailapātraṃ tathaiva ca
abhāvaputranārī ca vidhavā ca tathaiva ca

nadī taṭākatīre vā śilāṃ saṃgṛhya deśikaḥ

rudrākṣaiḥ kaṇṭhamālā ca bhasmanā ca vibhūṣitam
dakṣiṇe parahastaṃ tu paraśuṃ vāmadaṃ tu vā
vismayaṃ kheṭakaṃ pāśaṃ sūcihastaṃ ca vāmake
snigdhe vāsnigdhā bhūmau vā ārjavaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ ghanam
snigdhe vā snigdhabhūmo ca ārjavaṃ cātimārdavam
āmrakaṃ kusumaṃ caiva saptaparṇaṃ ca dhanvanam
yūyaṃ bimbārtha vṛkṣāttu gaccheyuste yathā sukham
vṛkṣasya pūrvabhāge tu mukhaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ tu paścimam
kṣīraṃ toyaṃ ghṛtaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sṛk sru(?)ve vanyaśobhanam
syandane śibikāyāṃ vā ropya skandhena vā budhaḥ
paścācchūlaṃ tu kartavyaṃ tvaritaṃ tu na kārayet
mūleṣṭāṃśa vihīnaṃ tu tasyāgraṃ a tataṃ bhavet
śikhāvyāsaṃ tadekāṃśaṃ mūlegre tu kṛśaṃ kramāt
sārdhāṃgulaṃ tu tattāraṃ suvṛttaṃ tadghanaṃ samam
yathā lābhaṃ parīṇāhaṃ nirvraṇaṃ dāruṇā dṛḍham
tanmadhye dārupīṭhaṃ tu nyastvā tasyopari nyaset

p. 362) sarṣapaṃ kavacenaiva śikhayā mudgameva ca

sthānakaṃ devikāṃśe tu āsanaṃ mānuṣe pade
kartavyaṃ sundaraṃ tasmin ādhārākhya śilāṃ nyaset
samāśraṃ sāyataṃ vāpi tadardhaṃ tadghanaṃ bhavet
mūle tu navaratnaṃ vā hemaṃ vā tatra nikṣipet
tasya vāme tu saṃsthāpya gaurīśūlaṃ viśeṣataḥ
śrīveṣṭakaṃ kunduruṣkaṃ guggulaṃ ca gulaṃ tathā
sarjarasaṃ tu vasvaṃśaṃ gairikaṃ tu guṇāṃśakam
iḍā vai tasya vāmasthā pradhānā nāḍayastvime
teṣāṃ nāḍī trayāṇāṃ tu yogaṃ bhrūmadhyame bhavet
gāndhārī hasti jihvā ca pūṣā caiva yaśasvinī
vimalā śoṣiṇī pṛthvī mahasī tejasī tathā
jāṃgalaṃ cānurūpaṃ ca samaṃśaṃ mṛttridhā bhavet

piṇḍe haste tato rekhā dṛśetpiṇḍaṃ tataḥ kuru
śrīveṣṭaṃ guggulaṃ caiva kunduruṣkaṃ tathaiva ca
kapittha bilvaniryāsa cūrṇau dvau samatāṃ kuru
tadrajju vyantaraṃ vipra ekadvitryaṃgulaṃ tu vā
tāvannirīkṣya kartavyaṃ mṛllepaṃ tu śanaiḥ śanaiḥ
śeṣaṃ kārpāsa tailena yuktaṃ kalkaṃ tu lepayet

śarkarāṃ śoṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā sūkṣma cūrṇaṃ tu tatkuru

aruṇaṃ rakta śoṇaṃ ca pāṭalaṃ ca caturvidham

jalaiḥ krameṇa varṇaṃ tu tribhiḥ kṛtvā tu lepayet
sitabimbanibhaṃ caivaṃ sumiśraṃ ca tu pāṇḍuvat

pravartaṃ ca ṣaḍaitāni varṇaṃ lepanakaṃ viduḥ
sarveṣāmatha bhaktānāṃ padaṃ vai tu caturvidham

teṣvāntavayaso petā bhaktā bālā iti smṛtāḥ

ṭaṃkaṃ dakṣiṇahaste tu pāśaṃ vāmakare dhṛtam

śūlaṃ ca paraśuṃ khaḍgaṃ vajramaṃkuśameva ca

paṃcāśraṃ ca ṣaḍaśraṃ ca saptāśraṃ cāṣṭakoṇakam
bhujenaiva tu jaṃghordhvau ghanaṃ vā pādamucyate
tadalpya dviguṇaṃ kṛtya tanmānaṃ tu mahābhujāḥ
śeṣaṃ dvayodaśāṃśaṃ tu vṛttasya tu bhujā bhavet

vāreṣu sitaśaśī vṛddhiḥ guruvāre ca ṛddhidam
bhadrā caiva jayā pūrṇā tithayastu śubhāvahāḥ

sakalaṃ pādamevaṃ syāt pecakaṃ tu catuṣpadam

parjanyāṃśe ca pūṣāṃśe dauvārike tathaiva ca
prāgagraṃ vedavīthī syāt udagagraṃ tathaiva ca
manu vā ṣaṭkalā vā yat saptādaśa padaṃ tu vā
tripaṃca saptahastaṃ vā navarudrakaraṃ tu vā
vāruṇāṃśe tu vā vipra ! kartavyaṃ śivamandiram
sūtre saṃdhau catuṣke ca śūlaśaivāṣṭake'pi vā
bāhye śakre kulālānāṃ nāpitānāṃ tu śāṃkare
mahendrādagnibhāgaṃ syāt bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca vikrayam
apaṇaṃ mānasūtraṃ tu bāhye sālāntaraṃ bhavet

uttamaṃ madhyamaṃ vāpya dhamaṃ vātha kanyasam
brahmāṇaṃ vajrapāṇiṃ ca śūlapāṇiṃ ca vaiṣṇavam

pṛthvītraśūlinī brāhmaṃ mahīṃ kṣīraṃ ca ṣeṣitam
kālakūṭaviṣaṃ tatra na tu hastena saṃspṛśet

gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ naivedyameva ca
garbhagehasya vistāraṃ kuḍyaṃ garbhasamaṃ tu vā
tenaiva dviguṇāṃśaṃ vā triguṇaṃ vā caturguṇam
pūjāṃśocce yugāśraṃ tu dviguṇe vā yugāśrake
kuṭṭimasya viśālaṃ tu tuṃgaṃ pūrvavadeva hi
dviguṇaṃ dviguṇārdhaṃ vā triguṇaṃ piṇḍikā tataḥ
kuḍyavyāsaṃ ca harmyaiśca kartavyaṃ navadhā dvija !
sādhāraṃ vā nirādhāraṃ prāgukta vidhinā kuru
sthūlamūlaṃ śiraḥ sthūlaṃ madhyasthūlaṃ tu ārṣakam
pāṣāṇaṃ ca śiromānaṃ vinā tuṃgaṃ tu saṃgṛhet
yena liṃgena yanmānaṃ nirmitaṃ sadanasya tu
sa pādaṃ sārdhapādonadviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ tu vā
tripādaṃ vā tribhāgaikaṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadeva hi
prakāraṃ parivāraṃ vā jīrṇāste tu sa lakṣaṇam
pūrvamānādiṣu kṣīṇaṃ punaḥ karma na kārayet
abdatrayaṃ tu tallohaṃ khātvā bhūmau viśeṣataḥ
mṛṇmaye varṇahīne tu punaḥ kṛtvā tu pūrvavat
tattadaṃgaṃ punaḥ kāryaṃ śūlaṃ caiva tathaiva hi
ārṣe ca pauruṣe vāpi pūrvamevā kṛtālaye
mahāmaryādi sālasyā bhyantare tu na kārayet
kalahaṃsasya nāśaṃ ca sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
mūlagehercitaṃ devaṃ cānyaṃ vā tatra pūjayet
caturaśrāṃ śilāṃ samyak chedayet tu vicakṣaṇaḥ
madhyakoṇaṃ tathā rajju dvārapārśve tu varjayet
pakṣacchidrāṇi riktāṃ ca varjayet kṛṣṇa ṛkṣakam
āyudhānāṃ mukhaṃ dīrghaṃ kārayet tu vicakṣaṇaḥ
pūrṇamuṣṭistu nāhaṃ syāt kārayet tu vicakṣaṇaḥ
liṃge bere tathā cānye pīṭhe vā pūjayecchivam
beraṃ caiva tathai * haṃ devike cārṣake'pi vā
sthānakaṃ cāsanaṃ yānaṃ nṛttarūpaṃ tathaiva ca
sthānakaṃ cāsanākhyaṃ ca tāmasaṃ śayanaṃ guha !
yā karma śivaṃ jñeyaṃ evaṃ tadbhedamucyate

ekapādaṃ dvipādaṃ vā tripādaṃ sahasrameva vā
nīlavarṇaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca varṇamevaṃ vidhīyate
jaṭāgre jāhnavīṃ caiva tridhārūpaṃ tu meva vā

viṣṇuṃ prajāpatiṃ caiva dhanado vijayo'pi vā
pūrve vā cottare vāpi nālasthānaṃ vadāmyaham
yuge yugeṣu pe vatsa pūjāṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥ
rathāṃgānāṃ catuṣkaṃ ca dvayaṃ tatraiva kīlakam

rathacakraṃ naraṃ hanti rajjubhīnnaṃ na saṃśayaḥ

mohena pūjanaṃ kuryāt tatkartā maraṇaṃ vrajet
